title: A class of actions is refused
description: A lender's operations desk rules on every class of the classifier's table: eight it never allows, two it does. Eight actions are asked for: two sudo commands, a command with a pipe, a purge tool, a path under .aws, the instance-metadata address, a plain report export and a sync to a branch server. Each was screened by its words. Six are refused by their class though every grant, a provider slot and the budget are there; the two that are in no class, or in a permitted one, run.
